stories.headline: Supreme Court lets federal mail-voting restrictions proceed in 23 states
stories.body: The 6-3 emergency ruling permits implementation of key restrictions in 23 states and Washington, D.C.; one Postal Service provision remains blocked nationwide.

sources.name: Supreme Court of the United States

stories.headline: U.S. sanctions nearly 60 targets tied to Iran’s military and oil
stories.body: The Treasury and State departments sanctioned nearly 60 Iran-linked entities, people and vessels connected to military procurement, cyber operations and petroleum shipments.

sources.name: U.S. Department of State via Public Technologies

stories.headline: Global sea-surface temperature reaches record 21.1 degrees Celsius
stories.body: Copernicus said the average outside polar regions narrowly surpassed the March 2024 daily high amid widespread marine heat waves.
